description: This file defines the 'DittoJsonException' class, a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to adapt JsonRuntimeExceptions into DittoRuntimeExceptions, adding headers and HTTP status information. It provides constructors and static methods to wrap exceptions thrown during JSON processing, with additional context and error handling.

classes.name: DittoJsonException
classes.description: A custom exception class that wraps JsonRuntimeExceptions or RuntimeExceptions and adds Ditto-specific headers and HTTP status code information for error handling within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: DittoJsonException
methods.description: Constructs a new DittoJsonException by wrapping a JsonRuntimeException or RuntimeException, adding headers and error codes.

methods.name: wrapJsonRuntimeException
methods.description: Wraps a function that may throw JsonRuntimeException or other runtime exceptions into a method that catches and re-throws as DittoJsonException.

methods.name: wrapJsonRuntimeException
methods.description: Wraps a Supplier, catching exceptions and rethrowing as DittoJsonException.

methods.name: wrapJsonRuntimeException
methods.description: Wraps a function with an argument and headers, catching exceptions and rethrowing as DittoJsonException with context.
